falsification_contract.HYPOTHESIS: expected effect holds: Stabilized fuel rail pressure and flow during transient maneuvers (e.g., turn-lane acceleration), preventing momentary fuel starvation that causes engine stall, analogous to the 6–8% efficiency gain a (recorded prior 0.6, epistemic class MODEL_DERIVED per the killer-experiment provenance)
falsification_contract.TREATMENT: Replace the fixed/voltage-regulated fuel pump driver with a variable frequency drive on the pump motor governed by a closed-loop PID controller that tracks downstream fuel rail pressure and temperature emulating in-vehicle demand on the dynamometer (and applies equivalently to in-vehicle control by commanding pump speed from rail pressure error rather than fixed PWM duty).
falsification_contract.CONTROL: the physics stage's executed BASELINE_COMPARISON arm (lifecycle verdict BEATS_BASELINE) — the baseline the candidate was measured against in the same evaluation
falsification_contract.MEASUREMENT: At the 2021 Chevrolet Equinox no-stall operating point, swapping fixed-duty pump control for closed-loop PID pump-speed control reduces peak-to-peak fuel rail pressure pulsation by at least one order of magnitude (analogous to the 10 kPa → 1.2 kPa charge-air drop observed) and lowers the coefficient of variation of metered fuel mass per stroke, which should eliminate the turn-lane stall under matched thermal and load transients.
falsification_contract.APPARATUS: the falsification test's own recorded instrumentation (stated within MEASUREMENT; not split out — no separate apparatus record exists)
falsification_contract.SAMPLE_BLOCKER: no sample-size / n= record exists in any engine stage (honest UNKNOWN — Art. XXV)
falsification_contract.ACCEPTANCE_THRESHOLD_BLOCKER: the recorded expected effect carries no numeric band ('Reduction in fuel rail pressure pulsation amplitude and tighter control of delivered fuel density, cutting stall-inducing flow transients and stabilizing comman') — a prose expectation is not an acceptance threshold (Art. LII/XXVII: the band is not invented by inference); the candidate must state the measurable quantity and its band
falsification_contract.FALSIFICATION_THRESHOLD_BLOCKER: the kill outcome cannot be stated NUMERICALLY from records: the recorded expected effect carries no numeric band — a prose kill sentence is not a threshold (R478 P0-3; Art. LII/XXVII: the band is not invented)
falsification_contract.UNCERTAINTY: all priors MODEL_DERIVED; no EXPERIMENTALLY_ESTIMATED inputs exist at this stage (Art. XXVIII/XXXVIII: no synthetic shortcut to physical observation)
